The squared best-infinity/Frobenius ratio is (n-1)(m-1)/(nm) from the projected coordinate functional. Standard-library exact checks passed 4033 comparisons including 576 witness pairs; these are corroborating only.

value.rationale: The two-margin space is a canonical pure-interaction object of rectangular factorial tables and a natural complete-bipartite cycle-flow subspace. Its optimal Euclidean Hilbert distortion is a structural invariant with a sharp parity-sensitive classification. Even-even sizes saturate the dimension-maximal bound, while odd sides impose quantitatively exact geometric obstructions; the result optimizes over arbitrary Euclidean coordinates and exhibits explicit extremizers.
